        script.async = true;

        script.addEventListener("error", onError, { once: true });

    const innerH = Math.max(1, refH - 2 * TEXT_PAD_REF);
    const key = [str, family, weight, maxPx, autoFit ? 1 : 0, innerW.toFixed(2), innerH.toFixed(2)].join("\u0001");
    const cached = _layoutCache.get(key);
    if (cached)
        return cached;
    const ctx = getMeasureCtx();
    const paragraphs = str.split(/\r?\n/).map(tokenizeParagraph);
    // Thai stacks vowels/tone marks above and below the line, so it needs more line height than Latin
    const lhRatio = THAI_RE.test(str) ? 1.4 : 1.2;
    const setFont = (px) => { ctx.font = `${weight} ${px}px ${family}`; };
    const build = (px, allowBreakWord) => {
        setFont(px);
        const lines = [];
        paragraphs.forEach((tokens) => lines.push(...wrapTokens(ctx, tokens, innerW, allowBreakWord)));
        return lines;
    };
    const fits = (px) => {
        const lines = build(px, false);
        let widest = 0;
        for (const l of lines)
            widest = Math.max(widest, ctx.measureText(l).width);
        return widest <= innerW + 0.01 && lines.length * px * lhRatio <= innerH + 0.01;
    };
    let px = maxPx;
    let lines;
    if (!autoFit) {
        lines = build(px, true);
    }
    else if (fits(maxPx)) {
        lines = build(maxPx, false);
    }
    else if (!fits(MIN_FIT_FONT_PX)) {
        px = MIN_FIT_FONT_PX; // box is too small for anything sensible: shrink to the floor and break words
        lines = build(px, true);
    }
    else {
        let lo = MIN_FIT_FONT_PX;
        let hi = maxPx;
        for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
            const mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
            if (fits(mid))
                lo = mid;
            else
                hi = mid;
        }
        px = lo;
        lines = build(px, false);
    }
    setFont(px);
    const m = ctx.measureText("Hgกู้");
    const ascent = m.fontBoundingBoxAscent != null ? m.fontBoundingBoxAscent : px * 0.8;
    const descent = m.fontBoundingBoxDescent != null ? m.fontBoundingBoxDescent : px * 0.2;
    const lineHeight = px * lhRatio;
    const result = { fontPx: px, lineHeight, lines, ascent, descent, totalH: lines.length * lineHeight };
    if (_layoutCache.size > 3000)
        _layoutCache.clear();
    _layoutCache.set(key, result);
    return result;
}

// ---------- image library: image files uploaded inside the app, matched to products by file name ----------
// Why: links to images on other websites often fail (private files, hotlink protection, CORS), and
// they can taint the export canvas. Files uploaded here live inside the app, so preview AND export
// always work. The Excel sheet just names the file (e.g. AW_PSC086184_LA_3D_RS_CSalt_13g.png).
const IMAGE_FILE_RE = /\.(png|jpe?g|webp|gif|avif|svg|bmp)$/i;
const IMAGE_SLOTS = [
    { urlKey: "imageDataUrl", nameKey: "imageFileName", label: "Main Image" },
    { urlKey: "ingredientImageDataUrl", nameKey: "ingredientFileName", label: "Ingredient Image" },
    { urlKey: "materialImageDataUrl", nameKey: "materialFileName", label: "Material Image" },
    { urlKey: "logoImageDataUrl", nameKey: "logoFileName", label: "Logo" },
];
const isHttpUrl = (v) => typeof v === "string" && /^https?:\/\//i.test(v);
// "folder/sub/My%20File.PNG?x=1" -> "My File.PNG"
const baseFileName = (value) => {
    let v = String(value == null ? "" : value).trim().replace(/^lib:\s*/i, ""); // "lib:file.png" = app link to a Library image
    v = v.split(/[?#]/)[0];
    v = v.slice(Math.max(v.lastIndexOf("/"), v.lastIndexOf("\\")) + 1);
    try {
        v = decodeURIComponent(v);
    }
    catch (e) { /* keep as is */ }
    return v.trim();
};
const fileKey = (name) => baseFileName(name).normalize("NFC").toLowerCase();
const fileKeyNoExt = (name) => fileKey(name).replace(/\.[a-z0-9]{2,5}$/i, "");
const guessMime = (name) => {
    const ext = (String(name).match(/\.([a-z0-9]+)$/i) || [])[1];
    const map = { png: "image/png", jpg: "image/jpeg", jpeg: "image/jpeg", webp: "image/webp", gif: "image/gif", avif: "image/avif", svg: "image/svg+xml", bmp: "image/bmp" };
    return map[(ext || "").toLowerCase()] || "image/png";
};
const libraryLink = (name) => `lib:${name}`;
async function copyTextToClipboard(text) {
    try {
        if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
            await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
            return true;
        }
    }
    catch (e) { /* fall through to the old way */ }
    try {
        const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
        ta.value = text;
        ta.style.position = "fixed";
        ta.style.opacity = "0";
        document.body.appendChild(ta);
        ta.select();
        const ok = document.execCommand("copy");
        document.body.removeChild(ta);
        return ok;
    }
    catch (e) {
        return false;
    }
}
const formatBytes = (n) => (n >= 1048576 ? `${(n / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MB` : `${Math.max(1, Math.round(n / 1024))} KB`);
const fileToDataUrl = (file) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const r = new FileReader();
    r.onload = () => resolve(r.result);
    r.onerror = () => reject(r.error);
    r.readAsDataURL(file);
});
const makeLibraryItem = (name, type, size, dataUrl, folder = "") => ({
    id: fileKey(name), key: fileKey(name), keyNoExt: fileKeyNoExt(name), name, type, size, dataUrl, folder: folder || "",
});
const FOLDER_ALL = "__all";
const FOLDER_NONE = "__none"; // images without a folder
const FOLDERS_LS_KEY = "image-library-folders";
const sortLibrary = (items) => [...items].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, undefined, { numeric: true }));
const mergeLibrary = (prev, added) => {
    const map = new Map(prev.map((i) => [i.key, i]));
    added.forEach((i) => { const old = map.get(i.key); map.set(i.key, { ...i, folder: i.folder || (old && old.folder) || "" }); }); // same file name = replace (keeps its folder unless a new one is given)
    return sortLibrary(Array.from(map.values()));
};
// Fill product image slots from the library. A slot is filled when the product names a file
// (from Excel's file-name columns, a file name typed in an image column, or the end of an image link)
// that exists in the library. Images the user attached by hand on a product card are never replaced.
function applyLibraryToProducts(list, library) {
    const byKey = new Map();
    const byNoExt = new Map();
    for (const i of library) {
        byKey.set(i.key, i);
        if (!byNoExt.has(i.keyNoExt))
            byNoExt.set(i.keyNoExt, i);
    }
    const missing = new Set();
    let matched = 0;
    let changed = false;
    const next = list.map((p) => {
        let np = null;
        for (const slot of IMAGE_SLOTS) {
            const cur = p[slot.urlKey];
            const fromLib = !!(p.libSlots && p.libSlots[slot.urlKey]);
            if (cur && !isHttpUrl(cur) && !fromLib)
                continue; // attached by hand — leave alone
            let wanted = p[slot.nameKey] || "";
            if (!wanted && isHttpUrl(cur)) {
                const b = baseFileName(cur);
                if (IMAGE_FILE_RE.test(b))
                    wanted = b; // link ends in a file name, e.g. .../13g/AW_PSC086184.png
            }
            if (!wanted)
                continue;
            const hit = byKey.get(fileKey(wanted)) || byNoExt.get(fileKeyNoExt(wanted));
            if (hit) {
                matched++;
                if (cur !== hit.dataUrl || p[slot.nameKey] !== hit.name) {
                    np = np || { ...p, libSlots: { ...(p.libSlots || {}) } };
                    np[slot.urlKey] = hit.dataUrl;
                    np[slot.nameKey] = hit.name;
                    np.libSlots[slot.urlKey] = true;
                }
            }
            else if (!cur) {
                missing.add(baseFileName(wanted));
            }
        }
        if (np)
            changed = true;
        return np || p;
    });
    return { products: changed ? next : list, matched, missing: Array.from(missing), changed };
}
// the library is kept in the browser's IndexedDB so images survive a page reload
const IMG_DB_NAME = "packshot-studio";
const IMG_STORE = "image-library";
function openImageDb() {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        try {
            if (typeof indexedDB === "undefined")
                return reject(new Error("IndexedDB unavailable"));
            const req = indexedDB.open(IMG_DB_NAME, 1);
            req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
                if (!req.result.objectStoreNames.contains(IMG_STORE))
                    req.result.createObjectStore(IMG_STORE, { keyPath: "key" });
            };
            req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
            req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
        }
        catch (err) {
            reject(err);
        }
    });
}
async function idbRun(mode, fn) {
    const db = await openImageDb();
    try {
        return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const tx = db.transaction(IMG_STORE, mode);
            const out = fn(tx.objectStore(IMG_STORE));
            tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(out && out.result !== undefined ? out.result : undefined);
            tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
            tx.onabort = () => reject(tx.error);
        });
    }
    finally {
        db.close();
    }
}
const imageDbGetAll = () => idbRun("readonly", (st) => st.getAll());
const imageDbPutAll = (records) => idbRun("readwrite", (st) => { records.forEach((r) => st.put(r)); });
const imageDbDelete = (key) => idbRun("readwrite", (st) => { st.delete(key); });
const imageDbSetFolder = (key, folder) => idbRun("readwrite", (st) => {
    const g = st.get(key);
    g.onsuccess = () => { if (g.result)
        st.put({ ...g.result, folder: folder || "" }); };
});
const imageDbClear = () => idbRun("readwrite", (st) => { st.clear(); });
// ---------- main component ----------
function PackshotStudio() {

    const [frameImageDataUrl, setFrameImageDataUrl] = useState(DEFAULT_FRAME_IMAGE);

    const [activeTemplateId, setActiveTemplateId] = useState(SAMPLE_CHANNELS[0].templates[0].id);
    const [previewProductId, setPreviewProductId] = useState(SAMPLE_PRODUCTS[0].id);
    const [selectedElId, setSelectedElId] = useState(null);
    const [dragLayerId, setDragLayerId] = useState(null); // layer row currently being dragged
    const [dragOverLayer, setDragOverLayer] = useState(null); // { id, pos: "above" | "below" } drop indicator
    const [exportProductIds, setExportProductIds] = useState(products.map((p) => p.id));
    const [exportTemplateKeys, setExportTemplateKeys] = useState([`${SAMPLE_CHANNELS[0].id}:${SAMPLE_CHANNELS[0].templates[0].id}`]);
    const [exportSizes, setExportSizes] = useState([800]);
    const [exportFormat, setExportFormat] = useState("png");
    const [exportStatus, setExportStatus] = useState("");
    const [exportClientName, setExportClientName] = useState("");
    const [excelImportNote, setExcelImportNote] = useState("");
    const [view, setView] = useState("create"); // 'create' | 'images' | 'editor' | 'history'
    const [deliveries, setDeliveries] = useState(SAMPLE_DELIVERIES);
    const [historySearch, setHistorySearch] = useState("");
    const [historyChannelFilter, setHistoryChannelFilter] = useState("all");
    const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState(null);
    const [showTemplateModal, setShowTemplateModal] = useState(false);
    const [brokenImageUrls, setBrokenImageUrls] = useState({});
    const [imageProbeNote, setImageProbeNote] = useState("");
    const probedUrlsRef = useRef({});
    const markImageBroken = (src) => {
        if (!src)
            return;
        setBrokenImageUrls((prev) => (prev[src] ? prev : { ...prev, [src]: true }));
        probeImageLink(src);
    };
    // When a linked image fails to load, ask the host WHY (an <img> tag only says "failed") and show the
    // reason once under the Import button, e.g. a private Supabase bucket or a wrong file name.
    const probeImageLink = async (src) => {
        if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(src) || probedUrlsRef.current[src])
            return;
        probedUrlsRef.current[src] = true;
        let msg;
        try {
            const res = await fetch(src, { mode: "cors", cache: "no-store" });
            if (res.ok) {
                const type = res.headers.get("content-type") || "";
                msg = /^image\//i.test(type)
                    ? "The server returned the file but the browser couldn't draw it — check the file isn't corrupt and is PNG, JPG or WebP."
                    : `The link returns "${type || "unknown type"}" instead of an image — use a direct link to the image file itself.`;
            }
            else {
                let body = "";
                try {
                    body = (await res.text()).slice(0, 160);
                }
                catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
                if (/bucket not found/i.test(body))
                    msg = 'The host says "Bucket not found" — the bucket is not Public (Supabase: Storage → bucket → Edit bucket → turn on Public bucket) or the bucket name in the link is wrong.';
                else if (res.status === 404 || /not found/i.test(body))
                    msg = "File not found (404) — check the folder and file name in the link match exactly, including upper/lower case.";
                else if (res.status === 401 || res.status === 403)
                    msg = `Access denied (${res.status}) — the file is not public.`;
                else
                    msg = `The server answered ${res.status}${body ? ` — ${body}` : ""}.`;
            }
        }
        catch (err) {
            msg = "The browser couldn't reach the link (blocked, offline, or the host doesn't allow requests from this page).";
        }
        setImageProbeNote((prev) => prev || `Image link problem: ${msg}\n${src}`);
    };
    // ---- image library (files uploaded in the "Images" tab) ----
    const [library, setLibrary] = useState([]);
    const [libraryNote, setLibraryNote] = useState("");
    const [libraryBusy, setLibraryBusy] = useState(false);
    const [libraryFilter, setLibraryFilter] = useState("");
    const [libraryDragOver, setLibraryDragOver] = useState(false);

            return [];
        }
    });
    const [newFolderOpen, setNewFolderOpen] = useState(false);
    const [newFolderName, setNewFolderName] = useState("");
    const [renameFolderTo, setRenameFolderTo] = useState(null); // string while renaming the selected folder
    const [confirmDeleteFolder, setConfirmDeleteFolder] = useState(false);
    useEffect(() => {
        try {
            localStorage.setItem(FOLDERS_LS_KEY, JSON.stringify(extraFolders));
        }
        catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    }, [extraFolders]);
    const allFolders = Array.from(new Set([...extraFolders, ...library.map((i) => i.folder).filter(Boolean)])).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { numeric: true }));
    const getVisibleLibrary = () => {
        const q = libraryFilter.trim().toLowerCase();
        return library.filter((i) => {
            if (libraryFolder === FOLDER_NONE && i.folder)
                return false;
            if (libraryFolder !== FOLDER_ALL && libraryFolder !== FOLDER_NONE && i.folder !== libraryFolder)
                return false;
            return !q || i.name.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        });
    };

        const name = newFolderName.trim().replace(/[\\/]+/g, "-");
        if (!name)
            return;
        if (!allFolders.some((f) => f.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase()))
            setExtraFolders((prev) => [...prev, name]);
        setLibraryFolder(allFolders.find((f) => f.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase()) || name);
        setNewFolderName("");
        setNewFolderOpen(false);
    };

            await imageDbSetFolder(key, folder);
        }
        catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    };

        const to = (renameFolderTo || "").trim().replace(/[\\/]+/g, "-");
        const from = libraryFolder;
        setRenameFolderTo(null);
        if (!to || to === from)
            return;
        const keys = library.filter((i) => i.folder === from).map((i) => i.key);
        setLibrary((prev) => prev.map((i) => (i.folder === from ? { ...i, folder: to } : i)));
        setExtraFolders((prev) => Array.from(new Set(prev.filter((f) => f !== from).concat(to))));

            try {
                await imageDbSetFolder(k, to);
            }
            catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
        }
    };

        const from = libraryFolder;
        const keys = library.filter((i) => i.folder === from).map((i) => i.key);
        setLibrary((prev) => prev.map((i) => (i.folder === from ? { ...i, folder: "" } : i)));
        setExtraFolders((prev) => prev.filter((f) => f !== from));
        setConfirmDeleteFolder(false);
        setLibraryFolder(FOLDER_ALL);
        setLibraryNote(`Folder "${from}" deleted. Its ${keys.length} image(s) are now under "No folder" — nothing was removed.`);
        for (const k of keys) {
            try {
                await imageDbSetFolder(k, "");
            }
            catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
        }
    };

        const ok = await copyTextToClipboard(libraryLink(item.name));
        if (ok) {
            setCopiedLibKey(item.key);
            setTimeout(() => setCopiedLibKey((k) => (k === item.key ? "" : k)), 1500);
        }
        else
            setLibraryNote("Couldn't copy automatically — select the file name under the picture and copy it by hand.");
    };
    const copyAllLibraryLinks = async () => {
        const list = getVisibleLibrary().map((i) => libraryLink(i.name));
        const ok = await copyTextToClipboard(list.join("\n"));
        setLibraryNote(ok ? `Copied ${list.length} link(s) — paste them into your Excel image column (one per row).` : "Couldn't copy automatically — use Download list instead.");
    };
    const downloadLibraryList = () => {
        const esc = (v) => `"${String(v).replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
        const rows = [["File name", "Link for Excel", "Folder"], ...library.map((i) => [i.name, libraryLink(i.name), i.folder || ""])];
        const csv = "\uFEFF" + rows.map((r) => r.map(esc).join(",")).join("\r\n");
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8" }));
        const a = document.createElement("a");
        a.href = url;
        a.download = "image-library-links.csv";

                    return;
                setLibraryBusy(true);

                for (const r of records) {
                    try {
                        items.push(makeLibraryItem(r.name, r.type, r.size, await fileToDataUrl(r.blob), r.folder));
                    }

                }
                if (!cancelled) {
                    setLibrary(sortLibrary(items));

                }
            }
            catch (err) {
                // storage unavailable here — the library then only lasts until the page is closed
            }

        });
    }, [library]);
    const addFilesToLibrary = async (fileList) => {
        const all = Array.from(fileList || []);
        const files = all.filter((f) => (f.type && f.type.startsWith("image/")) || IMAGE_FILE_RE.test(f.name));
        if (!files.length) {
            setLibraryNote(all.length ? "None of those files are images — use PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or SVG." : "");
            return;
        }
        setLibraryBusy(true);
        setLibraryNote(`Adding ${files.length} image(s)...`);
        const items = [];
        const records = [];
        const folderSet = new Set();
        let failed = 0;
        for (const f of files) {
            try {
                const typed = f.type ? f : new Blob([f], { type: guessMime(f.name) }); // some systems give no type
                const dataUrl = await fileToDataUrl(typed);

                if (folder)
                    folderSet.add(folder);

                records.push({ key: fileKey(f.name), name: f.name, type: typed.type, size: f.size, blob: typed, folder });

    const centerElement = (elId, axis) => {
        updateTemplate((t) => ({
            ...t,
            elements: t.elements.map((e) => {
                if (e.id !== elId || e.locked)
                    return e;
                const patch = {};
                if (axis === "h" || axis === "both")
                    patch.x = Math.round(((100 - e.w) / 2) * 100) / 100;
                if (axis === "v" || axis === "both")
                    patch.y = Math.round(((100 - e.h) / 2) * 100) / 100;
                return { ...e, ...patch };

        }));

        dragState.current = {
            mode,
            elId: el.id,
            startX: e.clientX,
            startY: e.clientY,
            orig: { x: el.x, y: el.y, w: el.w, h: el.h },
            stageW: stage.width,
            stageH: stage.height,
        };
        window.addEventListener("mousemove", onStageMouseMove);
        window.addEventListener("mouseup", onStageMouseUp);
    };
    const onStageMouseMove = (e) => {
        const d = dragState.current;
        if (!d)
            return;
        const dxPct = ((e.clientX - d.startX) / d.stageW) * 100;
        const dyPct = ((e.clientY - d.startY) / d.stageH) * 100;
        if (d.mode === "move") {
            let x = Math.min(Math.max(d.orig.x + dxPct, 0), 100 - d.orig.w);
            let y = Math.min(Math.max(d.orig.y + dyPct, 0), 100 - d.orig.h);
            updateElement(d.elId, { x, y });
        }
        else {
            let w = Math.min(Math.max(d.orig.w + dxPct, 4), 100 - d.orig.x);
            let h = Math.min(Math.max(d.orig.h + dyPct, 4), 100 - d.orig.y);
            updateElement(d.elId, { w, h });

    };
    const removeElement = (elId) => {

    const moveElement = (elId, direction) => {
        updateTemplate((t) => {

            const swapWith = direction === "up" ? idx + 1 : idx - 1;
            if (swapWith < 0 || swapWith >= t.elements.length)
                return t;
            const elements = [...t.elements];
            [elements[idx], elements[swapWith]] = [elements[swapWith], elements[idx]];

    const moveElementTo = (dragId, targetId, pos) => {
        if (!dragId || !targetId || dragId === targetId)

            if (!dragged)

            const src = key === "blank" ? null : channels.flatMap((c) => c.templates).find((t) => t.id === key);

        const elements = sourceTpl ? sourceTpl.elements.map((e) => ({ ...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(e)), id: uid() })) : [];
        const t = { id: uid(), name, elements };

    // delete one template from the active channel. The new list is written to storage straight away so a

    const handleLogoUpload2 = (e) => {

            const XLSX = await loadXLSX();
            const buf = await file.arrayBuffer();
            const wb = XLSX.read(buf, { type: "array" });
            const sheetName = wb.SheetNames.find((n) => /product/i.test(n)) || wb.SheetNames[0];
            const sheet = wb.Sheets[sheetName];
            const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, { defval: "" });

                return;

            const getField = (row, ...candidates) => {

                for (const k of Object.keys(row))
                    normalizedRow[k.trim().toLowerCase()] = row[k];
                for (const c of candidates) {
                    const v = normalizedRow[c.trim().toLowerCase()];
                    if (v !== undefined && v !== "")

                }
                return "";

            const splitImageCell = (raw) => {

                .map((r) => {
                const main = splitImageCell(getField(r, "Main Image URL", "ลิงก์รูปสินค้าหลัก (URL)", "Image URL", "Main packshot", "Main Image"));
                const ingr = splitImageCell(getField(r, "Ingredient Image URL", "ลิงก์รูปส่วนผสม (URL)", "Flavor", "Flavour", "Ingredient"));
                const mat = splitImageCell(getField(r, "Material Image URL", "Material"));
                const logo = splitImageCell(getField(r, "Logo Image URL", "Logo"));
                return {
                    id: uid(),
                    name: getField(r, "Product Name", "ชื่อสินค้า", "Name", "Name of Product") || "Untitled",

                    ingredientFileName: getField(r, "Ingredient Image Filename", "ชื่อไฟล์รูปส่วนผสม") || ingr.file,

                return;

            const USED_HEADERS = ["product name", "ชื่อสินค้า", "name", "name of product", "keyword", "คีย์เวิร์ด", "size (qty)", "ขนาด (qty)", "qty", "ขนาด",
                "pack size", "จำนวนแพ็ค (pack size)", "จำนวนแพ็ค", "pack", "main image url", "ลิงก์รูปสินค้าหลัก (url)", "image url", "main packshot", "main image",
                "ingredient image url", "ลิงก์รูปส่วนผสม (url)", "flavor", "flavour", "ingredient", "material image url", "material", "logo image url", "logo",
                "main image filename", "ชื่อไฟล์รูปสินค้าหลัก", "ingredient image filename", "ชื่อไฟล์รูปส่วนผสม", "material image filename", "logo image filename"];
            const unusedHeaders = foundHeaders.filter((h) => h && !USED_HEADERS.includes(h.toLowerCase()));
            const unusedNote = unusedHeaders.length ? ` Columns not used: ${unusedHeaders.join(", ")}.` : "";

            const bits = [];

            let note = `Imported ${finalList.length} items successfully${bits.length ? ` (${bits.join("; ")})` : ""}.`;
            if (applied.missing.length) {
                note += ` Not found in the Image Library: ${applied.missing.slice(0, 4).join(", ")}${applied.missing.length > 4 ? ` +${applied.missing.length - 4} more` : ""} — upload these files in the Images tab.`;
            }

        }
        catch (err) {

    };
    // ---- canvas render + export ----
    const isExternalUrl = (src) => typeof src === "string" && /^https?:\/\//i.test(src);
    // Google Drive share links (the normal "Copy link" format) point to an HTML viewer page,

    const normalizeImageUrl = (url) => {
        if (!url || typeof url !== "string")

        if (!trimmed)
